description: Add daily glucosamine-chondroitin supplement for joint health
presentation: A 40-year-old man with erectile dysfunction presents with two elevated fasting morning prolactin measurements (27 ng/mL, then 30 ng/mL, ref range 2-18 ng/mL). He has no visual symptoms, headache, or renal disease. He takes no medications but takes a daily glucosamine-chondroitin supplement for joint health. Does patient need a brain MRI for prolactinoma?
